note: Anima direction cards, ported from art_directions.json (SDXL) for the Miao8 production line. Structural differences from the SDXL cards: (1) cfg=1 makes negative prompts inert, so there is NO neg_add slot -- every constraint the SDXL card pressed with negatives is either re-expressed as positive text (positive_guards, appended to the positive prompt) or demoted to a post-generation cull criterion (qc_cull, enforced by per-image QC, never by conditioning); (2) no style_loras -- the Anima LoRA ecosystem does not exist yet, style must carry through the medium/color slots alone; (3) base is always Miao8, cards do not switch checkpoints. Recipe numbers (steps/cfg/sampler/scheduler/shift) come from scripts/anima_models.json, never from cards. Density rule: assembled prompts must land at medium density or above (HAREM_PROMPT_GUIDE.md section 2). Cards whose color/light vocabulary is strong should be used with explicit hair/eye color locks in the subject slot. status lifecycle: unvalidated -> verified (2-seed batch passed + user review) / rejected (recorded honestly, kept for the archive).
